rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH region_institutions AS (
  SELECT
    i.unics_id,
    i.institutions_name,
    i.short_name,
    i.acronym,
    i.country_id,
    i.geocode_regions_3,
    i.grid_id,
    i.website,
    i.db_pedia_url,
    i.wikidata_url,
    -- institutions table does not have latitude/longitude; include NULLs to preserve columns
    NULL::numeric AS latitude,
    NULL::numeric AS longitude,
    u.geocode_regions AS region_code,
    u.description AS region_name,
    u.geocode_level,
    u.nuts_version
  FROM institutions i
  JOIN eu_territorial_units u
    ON i.geocode_regions_3 = u.geocode_regions
  WHERE u.description ILIKE '%nordjylland%'
)
SELECT *
FROM region_institutions

rows.question: Find all different topics of projects that ended in 2014

    pt.project::integer AS project,
    pt.topic::text AS topic
  FROM project_topics pt
),
topics_dim AS (
  SELECT
    t.code AS code,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.title, ''), NULLIF(btrim(t.rcn), ''), t.code) AS title,

  FROM topics t
),
projects_core_24 AS (

  FROM projects p
)

rows.question: Find distinct titles of topics of projects that with end year 2014
rows.pred_sql:

FROM projects p
JOIN project_topics pt ON p.unics_id = pt.project
JOIN topics t ON pt.topic = t.code

  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.title, ''), NULLIF(btrim(t.rcn), ''), t.code) AS title
